method: An isolated headless Chrome profile captured the current unified Worker site through Chrome DevTools Protocol. JPEG frames were encoded as silent MP4 clips. The user's active browser was not used.
scope: These are short, visually inspected production review clips. They do not establish full final-scene coverage, provider role acceptance, a physical-device run, or submission of the feedback draft.
